dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can give you a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Oh my, dear customer, Zhaka could learn a thing or two from you! Not only did you find the dolls, but you painted them in record time as well!

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: When he gets back, I'll make sure he asks you for some pointers. Please accept these as payment!

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Ugh, that Zhaka... ditched work before finishing his job! And god knows where he stashed those dolls! I am so gonna file a complaint!

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Dolls modeled on Koholasaurs. I've been painting them.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: But Zhaka, my apprentice, hasn't been showing up for work lately. He still has three left to paint, and I've got no idea where he put them.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Would you mind helping me look for them? I think they should be nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Kanei
dialogues.text: Oh, that's alright. I'll handle it myself.
